Title: Data Science Engineer
Location: Centro de San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: ROLE PURPOSE Build the data foundation and data science capabilities that enable artificial intelligence across our engineering organization. Connect, organize and maintain the data that engineering teams create every day, such as requirements, designs, test results, reviews and issue reports, so it can be used reliably by AI solutions, analytics and engineers themselves. Develop analyses and predictive models that turn engineering data into insights and better decisions. Measure how engineering work is performed today and how AI improves it, giving the organization clear and trustworthy evidence of value. Work independently with AI engineers, engineering teams and IT to deliver data that is high quality, secure and easy to use, and act as the team’s technical reference for data and data science. KEY FUNCTIONAL OBJECTIVES Reliable, well-organized engineering data available for AI solutions, analytics and reporting. Clear measurement of engineering processes before and after AI adoption, showing real impact. Analytics and predictive models that help engineering teams anticipate issues and make better decisions. Fast access to approved, ready-to-use data so new AI ideas can be tested quickly. Data quality and consistency that engineers and leaders can trust. Secure and responsible data handling that protects company and customer information. Reusable data pipelines and tools that make each new AI solution faster and cheaper to build. Main Responsibilities Data Integration & Pipelines Design, build and operate data pipelines that collect data from engineering tools, such as requirements management, version control, testing systems and issue trackers. Create and maintain a common data model so information from different teams and projects can be combined and compared. Automate data updates, monitoring and alerts so pipelines run reliably with minimal manual effort. Document data sources, owners and data flows in a catalog that is easy for others to use. Lead the design of the team’s data architecture and tooling (for example, Databricks, Azure and Git-based workflows) within IT-approved platforms. Data Quality & Structure Define and track data-quality rules for completeness, consistency, duplicates and missing links between related records. Identify gaps between related engineering information, for example requirements that have no associated test, and report them to the owning teams. Work with engineering teams to fix data issues at the source. Turn unstructured content, such as documents and spreadsheets, into structured and searchable data. Measurement, Analytics & Data Science Measure how engineering processes perform today, including effort, rework, waiting time and defects, to create a reliable starting point. Develop statistical analyses and predictive models on engineering data to identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities, and validate results with engineering teams. Build dashboards that show AI adoption, quality and business impact over time. Track how engineers accept or reject AI suggestions so the quality of each AI solution can be measured and improved. Provide clear, reproducible data to support business cases and leadership decisions. Data for AI Solutions Prepare data for AI applications, including document processing, search indexes and embeddings used by large language models. Build and maintain test datasets, created together with engineers, to evaluate AI solutions before and after each change. Provide safe datasets, including synthetic or anonymized data where needed, so prototypes can start quickly. Support the move of successful prototypes into production with robust, scalable data pipelines. Data Governance & Security Apply company information-classification and access rules to every dataset and environment. Use only approved tools and platforms, protecting intellectual property and customer information. Keep clear records of data sources, changes and usage to support audits and quality reviews. Partner with IT and information security on data policies and incident prevention. Collaboration & Technical Leadership Act as the data partner for AI engineers, engineering teams, IT and business stakeholders. Join conversations with engineering teams to understand how they work and where their data comes from. Act as technical reference for data and data science within the team; coach the AI Engineer, Jr. AI Engineer and intern on data quality, analytics and self-service reporting. Lead data and analytics workstreams or project steps end to end with minimal guidance. Experience & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics or a related field; advanced degree or data certifications are a plus. 5+ years of experience in data engineering or data science, including building and operating production data pipelines. Advanced Python and SQL; solid experience with data modeling, data orchestration and data-quality practices. Solid knowledge of statistics, machine learning and predictive modeling applied to business or engineering data. Experience with cloud data platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric and Power BI. Experience integrating data from business or engineering tools through APIs (for example, Jira, Git or similar). Experience preparing data for AI and large language model applications, such as document processing, embeddings, vector search and test datasets. Knowledge of data governance, access control and data-security practices. Experience in automotive, electronics or other engineering-driven industries is a plus. Familiarity with automotive engineering processes such as Automotive SPICE (ASPICE) is a plus. Fluent English and Spanish, with the ability to explain data topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Establish clear accountability, strengthen leadership and technical capabilities, and foster collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement across the teams. Executive Communication and Business Recommendations. Present an integrated view of merchandising performance, financial outlook, assortment opportunities, and catalog coverage to senior leadership, highlighting business implications, trade-offs, and recommended actions Lead a team of 24+ professionals in areas as Merchandising Analytics, Content and Assortment A Master's degree (MA, MS, MBA) or equivalent. Engineering, Finance or Accounting. More than seven years. Proven experience leading cross-functional teams in catalog content management, data-driven assortment strategy, and coverage acceleration, with a strong background in analytics, merchandising, and operational execution.
